assumptions.execution: Hypothetical fills at assumed spread; no market impact, order queue or liquidity simulation.
assumptions.history: At runtime each frame receives up to300 observations at or before its time; no future prices.
assumptions.missingMinutes: Only minutes observed for BOTH assets are retained. Missing minutes are not filled. Actual elapsed time must be used.
assumptions.quoteTime: Replay observedAt is the historical candle-close time in simulated time, not an actual archived quote receipt.
assumptions.spread: ASSUMED bid=close*(1-0.0002), ask=close*(1+0.0002); historical bid/ask were not fetched
